status: Analytical feasibility only. Not a selected next run, approved allocation, implementation, or demonstrated mixing improvement.

source.citation: Schwabe (2016), Appendix A, printed pp. 131–133 / PDF pages 140–142.

notation.C: Zero-mean shared environmental effect, one per family.
notation.A: Additive genetic effect, shared exactly by MZ cotwins.
notation.likelihood: theta_t | A,C ~ Normal(mu+C+A_t, variance exp(beta0+beta1*A_t)); y_tk | theta_t ~ Bernoulli(logistic(theta_t-b_k)). Preserve actual responses and fixed known item difficulties.

unchanged_priors: Independent ta, tc ~ Gamma(shape=1, rate=1). Thus va and vc have inverse-Gamma(shape=1, scale=1) priors, not flat variance priors.
mu and beta1 ~ Normal(0, variance=10); beta0 ~ Normal(0, variance=1); ve=exp(beta0).
Do not replace these with priors on total variance, variance proportions, or residual precision.

direct_centered_representation.MZ: A_i ~ Normal(0, va); define A_i1=A_i2=A_i deterministically. Keep two distinct theta values and both response vectors.
direct_centered_representation.DZ: A_i1 ~ Normal(0, va); A_i2 | A_i1 ~ Normal(rho*A_i1, va*(1-rho^2)), with rho=1/2. The second conditional precision is ta/(1-rho^2)=4*ta/3.
direct_centered_representation.singularity: Never use the DZ conditional with rho=1: its variance becomes zero. Declare MZ and DZ genetic coordinates separately. MZ genetic dimension is one, not two.
direct_centered_representation.monitors: Reassemble the original family order and all a[i,t], c[i], theta[i,t], and p[i,t,k] nodes. Preserve the same fourteen monitored columns, including selected family-1 MZ nodes and derived log variances.

joint_target_equivalence.baseline_map: C=sqrt(vc)*zc; MZ A=sqrt(va)*za; DZ A1=sqrt(va)*za and A2=sqrt(va)*(rho*za+sqrt(1-rho^2)*zb). Active z coordinates are independent standard normals.
joint_target_equivalence.forward_Jacobian: J = vc^(N/2) * va^(n_MZ/2+n_DZ) * (1-rho^2)^(n_DZ/2). This is the absolute determinant for active z -> (C,A) coordinates. Including unchanged global parameters makes the full transform block triangular, so parameter dependence adds no further determinant.
joint_target_equivalence.density_identity: p_centered(C,A,globals,theta,y) = p_noncentered(z(C,A,globals),globals,theta,y) / J. The normal densities and 1/J give exactly the centered C, MZ A, and DZ bivariate normal densities. The substituted theta/item likelihood is identical. The joint target for mapped scientific variables is therefore unchanged.
joint_target_equivalence.unused_MZ_auxiliary: The baseline also declares an unused standard-normal zb for MZ families because its coefficient is zero. Retain it as an independent auxiliary for an augmented-space bijection, or integrate it out. Removing it is marginalization, not an invertible two-to-one dimensional transformation.
joint_target_equivalence.variance_prior_warning: If va rather than ta is declared stochastic, the Jacobian |dta/dva|=va^-2 is necessary; likewise for vc. Retaining the original Gamma precision priors avoids this accidental prior change.

full_conditionals.direct_ta: ta | A,rest ~ Gamma(1+(n_MZ+2*n_DZ)/2, 1+0.5*(sum_MZ A_i^2 + sum_DZ A_i^T R^-1 A_i)), where R^-1=[[1,-rho],[-rho,1]]/(1-rho^2). For 140 MZ and 360 DZ families the shape is 431.
full_conditionals.direct_tc: tc | C,rest ~ Gamma(1+N/2, 1+0.5*sum_i C_i^2). For N=500 the shape is 251.
full_conditionals.reason: Conditional on centered A and C, the theta likelihood no longer depends directly on ta or tc. Their remaining factors are Gaussian latent densities and Gamma priors. In the current noncentered representation, A and C depend on ta/tc inside the likelihood.
full_conditionals.limits: These identities establish conditional conjugacy, not automatic JAGS sampler selection or improved mixing. beta0 and beta1 still enter residual variance exponentially. ve does not gain a Gamma conditional under its unchanged lognormal prior.

source_F0_representation.MZ: Set C_source=mu+C and F=C_source+A. Then source a=F-C_source and theta has mean F. This translation has unit Jacobian; do not add mu again.
source_F0_representation.DZ: Let U,V1,V2 be independent Normal(0, va/2). Set F0=C_source+U, F_t=F0+V_t, and A_t=U+V_t. Then Var(A_t)=va and Cov(A1,A2)=va/2. Integrating U recovers the direct centered DZ bivariate normal.
source_F0_representation.augmentation: This uses three genetic coordinates to represent two mapped DZ effects. The transform (U,V1,V2)->(U,A1,A2) has unit Jacobian, followed by marginalization over U. It is not a two-to-three dimensional bijection. U | A1,A2 ~ Normal((A1+A2)/3, va/6).
source_F0_representation.augmented_ta: ta | U,V,A_MZ,rest ~ Gamma(1+(n_MZ+3*n_DZ)/2, 1+0.5*sum_MZ A_i^2+sum_DZ(U_i^2+V_i1^2+V_i2^2)). The fixed-case shape is 611. This differs from 431 because of the additional auxiliary variables, not a changed marginal prior.
source_F0_representation.monitor_mapping: c_baseline=C_source-mu; a_t=F_t-C_source; theta_t=pheno_t; p=logistic(pheno_t-b). C_source is not the zero-mean c monitor, and F_t is not the genetic a monitor.
source_F0_representation.tradeoff: The F0 construction matches the printed latent factorization but introduces one extra auxiliary coordinate per DZ family. Direct centering is more compact. Neither has a demonstrated mixing advantage.

validation_required_before_any_implement: Independent algebra review of the Jacobian, auxiliary marginalization, and Gamma full conditionals.
Compare log joint densities at identical transformed latent/global states, including the parameter-dependent Jacobian, separately for MZ and DZ cases.
Validate DZ covariance and the F0 conditional analytically and with small nonposterior fixtures; assert MZ genetic equality and unchanged response ordering.
Preserve the actual prepared dataset, source priors, known b, monitor mappings, and fixed joint diagnostic criteria.
Define and record valid mapped latent initial states. Changed parameterization changes RNG consumption; identical seeds need not yield identical trajectories or imply new data.
Inspect actual JAGS sampler assignments if implemented. Conditional conjugacy alone does not establish engine optimization.
Obtain separate independent code review and a fixed resource plan in a fresh namespace. Do not automatically fall back from the current longer run.

Evaluate any future benchmark using the same estimands, adaptation records, rank Rhat, ESS per second, MCSE, HPD sensitivity, and all requested failures. Do not report only successful chains or parameters.
recommendation: If the current longer allocation fails, centering is a mathematically justified candidate for a separately reviewed experiment because it restores conditional ta/tc conjugacy while preserving the source target. The current baseline is already noncentered. No evidence yet establishes that centering, source F0 augmentation, or a hybrid improves overall mixing.
